briefing.headline: OpenAI Orion-2 edges out rivals in multi-agent reasoning benchmarks amid escalating compute race

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AGI race has intensified with major model releases from OpenAI and DeepSeek, while regulatory scrutiny grows over autonomous agent deployments. Funding remains robust but concentrated among hyperscalers. Safety gaps persist in production systems despite incremental alignment progress.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI deployed Orion-2 with 2.1T parameters showing gains in long-horizon planning. Anthropic's Claude 4 Opus and Google's Gemini 3 Ultra both launched this month. DeepSeek-V4 closed the gap on Western labs with open weights release.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and that DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level. New EU AI Act enforcement actions target agentic systems. Red-teaming reports highlight persistent jailbreak vectors in multi-model pipelines.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA announced Blackwell Ultra shipments ramping to 500k units monthly. Microsoft and xAI broke ground on joint Memphis Phase II cluster targeting 200k H100 equivalents by Q4. TSMC reported AI chip yield improvements to 78%.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will the first superintelligent system emerge from a closed Western lab or an open-source coalition by 2028?
